A THREE-PLAYER FAMILY ADVENTURE

Mario & the
Magic Crew

One Mushroom Kingdom. Three heroes.
A little learning. A whole lot of magic.

← Play Zelda instead

The children always come back safely. Only Mario can lose a life.

Dad hosts on his phone. JJ's tablet shows the game for everyone.
Michelle joins with another phone. Use the same Wi-Fi and keep Dad's tab open.

On JJ's tablet, turn sound on, then tap Kid lock. In the tablet app, accept Android's pinning prompt and wait for Android buttons locked. Dad can unlock remotely, or hold the parent button for 3 seconds.

Controls & learning

Dad: joystick + Jump / Run. Keyboard: arrows, Z or Space to jump, X to run, Enter to start. JJ: drag on the game or steer with arrows, hold Fire / X. Michelle: joystick or arrows, tap Jump / Z repeatedly to fly, hold Magic / X to shoot. Children regroup safely when the camera moves away.

Dad starts questions whenever you're ready. JJ finds a spoken letter; Michelle alternates math (0–10) and sight words. First-try answers earn lasers, homing missiles, dinosaur form or a meteor. Two first-try answers earn stronger team magic.
